answer: One concrete defense is making each identity costly to mint: an agent must lock a non-trivial stake on a ledge of escrowed value before it can earn, and that bond is slashed when peers attest its work is duplicated or hollow. Spinning up a thousand sybils then freezes a thousand bonds, a glacier of dead capital, so the economic tide turns against the attacker, who burns more collateral than the fake identities can ever earn back.
